title.value: An act to add Chapter 13.5 (commencing with Section 108970) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.
title.provenance: An act to add Chapter 13.5 (commencing with Section 108970) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

status.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: commencing January 1, 2025, no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.

who.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale

action.provenance: manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles

products.provenance: textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

value: Outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028
exceptions.provenance: Paragraph (1) does not apply to outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: No mention of 'currently unavoidable use' in the document.

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS means either of the following: (1) PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product
